modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from previous loom operator

pcs.pc_description: report for duty at least 15-20 minutes earlier than scheduled time to take stock of necessary operational tools, lot and quality changes

take a quick round of the allotted shuttleless looms with previous shift operator and discuss the issues faced related to quality, production, spares, fabric defects, safety or any other specific instructions, etc.
get complete information on type and specifications of fabric being and to be produced for allocated shuttleless looms
verify the technical details mentioned in the shuttleless loom card or display board of the loom and verify with the counterpart that the same are running on the allotted looms

inspect running beams for cross ends, ends pulling out, defective selvedges, etc.

verify the functioning of the allotted shuttleless looms, their parts and the loom mechanisms
ensure that the waste collection boxes are empty and labeled

assist the supervisor to prepare the shift handover report as per the standard protocol
assist the supervisor to calculate shuttleless loom production, efficiency percentage, etc.
